sketches.mechanism: The `object` declaration creates a singleton — exactly one instance, ever, enforced by the compiler. Combined with Kotlin's `companion object`, it exists only inside another and has no independent life.
sketches.resonance: A companion that is guaranteed to be singular and inseparable from its enclosing class mirrors the ache of a presence that cannot exist on its own.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table, filling NULLs where no match exists — the query structurally guarantees that absence is represented, never discarded.
sketches.resonance: The join keeps every person even when no one corresponds to them; the NULLs are the shape of who was missing.
sketches.draft:
SELECT everyone.name, beloved.name
FROM   everyone
LEFT JOIN beloved
ON     everyone.id = beloved.id

sketches.mechanism: The `finally` block executes regardless of whether the `try` succeeds or the `catch` fires — it runs after joy, after disaster, after everything.
sketches.resonance: No matter what happened — whether things went right or threw an exception — the finally block is what remains, the one act you always perform.
